authenticity.evidence: Only 36 unique sellers made about 2,974 sells in 1h, against 843 unique buyers (GeckoTerminal). That is roughly 80+ sells per seller, the signature of bots churning volume. $6.1M of volume on a $98k mcap is 35x turnover. GMGN flags 104 bundler wallets. The creator status is 'creator_close'. There are no organic mentions of this contract address anywhere. Attention to the Buttbrain narrative is real, but it belongs to the pump.fun token 3znS...pump.
authenticity.uncertainty: I couldn't search X directly. Part of the churn could come from confused buyers who mistook this for the real token.

structured_output.counterargument: 843 unique buyers is a lot, and the price is up about 48% in 1h. Confused buyers searching 'Buttbrain' might pick this pair because its liquidity is the deepest of all BRAIN pairs, so it may look like the real one. If the canonical token keeps running toward $1M+, spillover could carry this pair to 2x before any pull. It is also possible that the $175k LP is simply an unusually well-funded launch rather than a rug setup.

structured_output.thesis: This is a ticker hijack of Buttbrain AI, not the real token. The official site names 3znS...pump as the contract. This one is a non-pump.fun token that the creator put straight onto PumpSwap, seeded with $175k of unlocked liquidity (more than its own mcap). Volume comes from bots: 36 sellers against 843 buyers, $6M on a $98k cap. The most likely outcome is an LP pull once enough confused buyers have come in. A double would need a large amount of new money into a deliberately fake copy.
